{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
duplicate_patients = df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)
dup_count = duplicate_patients.sum()

# Check how many times each patient appears
dup_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()

# Look at the sample_seq for duplicated patients
duplicated_rows = df[duplicate_patients]
max_sample_seq_per_patient = duplicated_rows.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()

print(f"Total duplicate rows: {dup_count}")
print(f"Number of patients with duplicates: {len(dup_counts)}")
print(f"Max sample_seq per duplicated patient:\n{max_sample_seq_per_patient}")"}
